00037 /**
00038  * @brief Clipboard entry object
00039  *
00040  * This structure is an opaque object concerning installing one or more
00041  * clipboard elements to the clipboard.
00042  * The flow is to create a new clipboard entry, use it in various APIs,
00043  * and after use delete the entry in order to save memory */
00044 typedef struct _HxClipboardEntry_t HxClipboardEntry_t;
00045

00047 /**
00048  * @brief Create a new Clipboard entry 
00049  *
00050  * This function will create a new clipboard entry object that is used in
00051  * other APIs for adding elements for final inclusion to the clipboard. 
00052  *
00053  * @param hEntry        OUT:    Valid clipboard entry object
00054  *
00055  * @return HxResult     Returns HX_OK if a successful clipboard entry object is created.
00056  *
00057  **/
00058 HxResult HxClipboardNewEntry(HxClipboardEntry_t **hEntry);

00061 /**
00062  * @brief Delete a Clipboard entry 
00063  *
00064  * This function will delete an earlier created clipboard entry object so that 
00065  * the memory is no longer claimed. It will remove the pointers to the clipboard
00066  * entry elements, but any specific memory allocated by each element is not deleted.
00067  *
00068  * @param pEntry        IN:     Valid clipboard entry object
00069  *
00070  * @return HxResult     Returns HX_OK if a successful clipboard entry object is deleted.
00071  *
00072  **/
00073 HxResult HxClipboardDeleteEntry(HxClipboardEntry_t *entry);

00076 /**
00077  * @brief Add a clipboard element to the clipboard entry
00078  *
00079  * This function will add an entry to the clipboard element. You can
00080  * add one or more elements to the clipboard entry via multiple calls
00081  * of this function.  Note that the contents of memory pointed to by
00082  * the data parameter is not copied until you call the
00083  * HxClipboardSet() API, so this pointer must remain valid until that
00084  * time.
00085  *
00086  * @param pEntry        IN:     Valid clipboard entry object
00087  * @param type          IN:     MIME type
00088  * @param data          IN:     Pointer to the data for the clipboard element
00089  * @param size          IN:     Size of the clipboard element data
00090  *
00091  * @return HxResult     Returns HX_OK if a successful clipboard element is added to the entry.
00092  *
00093  **/
00094 HxResult HxClipboardAddElement( HxClipboardEntry_t *pEntry,
00095                                 HxMIMEType_t type,
00096                                 void *data,
00097                                 uint32_t size);
